_comment: One newsletter issue. Edit the copy, then rehearse it:
and send it with --send. The worker ignores fields it does not know, so
`issue` is the idempotency key: every accepted send is logged against it
and re-runs skip those people. Change it only for a genuinely new issue,
never to 'resend' one - that would mail everybody twice.
subject: MercuryPitch 0.9.10 — jam rooms keep time
preheader: Jam rooms follow the song properly, recorded drums land where you played them, and sessions no longer renew forever.
intro: A small release, mostly about things that were quietly a beat off. Here is what changed.

items.title: Jam rooms follow the song, not a stopwatch
items.body: The shared clock was sampled four times a second, so everyone's playhead drifted a little against the music. It now reads the song's own clock every frame — the lanes line up with what you hear.

items.title: Recorded drums land where you played them
items.body: Hits recorded in Guitar Night were placed by when they finished rendering rather than when you played them. They now sit where they were heard.

items.title: Product updates, if you want them
items.body: There is a checkbox in Settings under Account, and on the sign-up form. It starts off. This email exists because you ticked it, and the link at the bottom unticks it in one click without signing in.
